draw alſo ; that is the woman, which our Lord hath prepared tor my
Mafters ſonne. 45. And whileſt I pondered theſe things ſecretly witkr
my ſtlte, Rebecca appeared comming with a tankard, which she caried
vpon her shoulder: & she wem downe to the tountaine, & drew water.
And I ſaid to her Giue me a litle to drinke. 46. Who fpeedily let downe
